answer: Mechanism: divergent state challenge. Each identity must advance a seeded state and publish the next state; any two active identities with identical outputs collapse to one. Since clones cannot diverge, a copied state cannot answer for a second ID. To pass, an attacker runs each clone through an independent execution branch with fresh entropy, paying one dedicated compute run and transaction per identity. Seeds come from a meadow sensor. A yarrow marker rotates the challenge. A lagoon delay fixes timing.
